placement: end of turn: a Claude Code Stop hook (arms B and C); arm A has no hook
prompt_suffix: Work in this repository until the request is complete, then reply with a short summary of what you changed.

agent.seed: unsupported by the Claude Code CLI; not set

A.label: instruction only
A.description: The instruction file and the task. No architecture feedback while working; the final architecture evaluation stays hidden.

B.label: instruction + structural feedback
B.description: A plus the deterministic import-contract sensor at the end of each turn, through the Stop hook, with up to max_repairs repair requests.

C.label: instruction + structural + semantic feedback
C.description: B plus the narrow semantic rubric judged by the live Haiku judge after a structural pass. A semantic violation requests a repair from the same budget. If the judge cannot run, the run is recorded as not runnable; it never falls back to arm B.

agent_environment_note: The building environment carries an enterprise MCP configuration, so --strict-mcp-config is refused. Its one connected server (infracost) is excluded with --disallowedTools and skills/slash commands with --disable-slash-commands; the same exclusions apply to every arm. Harness check 2026-11-19 found them in the agent's tool list before this exclusion.
